rows.s_sql:
SET @prov_c := '%s';
SET @id:= '%s';
SET @cat_id := '%s';
SET @send :=  IF((SELECT active FROM sys_report WHERE cat_id = @cat_id and id = @id )=1,0,2);
SET @b_year:=(SELECT yearprocess FROM pk_byear LIMIT 1);
SET	@start_d:=concat(@b_year-1,'1001');
SET @end_d:=concat(@b_year,'0930');

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS s_ip_instype_all(
  id varchar(32) NOT NULL,
  hospcode varchar(5) DEFAULT NULL,
  areacode varchar(8) DEFAULT NULL,
  flag_sent varchar(1) DEFAULT NULL,
  date_com varchar(14) DEFAULT NULL,
  b_year varchar(4) DEFAULT NULL,
  inscl_all int(9) DEFAULT 0,
  visit_all int(9) DEFAULT 0,
  inscl1 int(9) DEFAULT 0,
  inscl_visit1 int(9) DEFAULT 0,  
  inscl2 int(9) DEFAULT 0,
  inscl_visit2 int(9) DEFAULT 0,  
  inscl3 int(9) DEFAULT 0,
  inscl_visit3 int(9) DEFAULT 0,  
  inscl4 int(9) DEFAULT 0,
  inscl_visit4 int(9) DEFAULT 0,  
  inscl5 int(9) DEFAULT 0,
  inscl_visit5 int(9) DEFAULT 0,  
	PRIMARY KEY (id,hospcode,areacode,b_year),
	KEY (hospcode),
	KEY (areacode),
	KEY (b_year)

) ENGINE=MyISAM DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8;

DELETE FROM s_ip_instype_all WHERE id=@id AND b_year=(@b_year+543);

INSERT IGNORE INTO s_ip_instype_all 
(
	SELECT 
		 @id,hospcode,concat(h.provcode,h.distcode,h.subdistcode,SUBSTR(CONCAT('00',h.mu),-2)) as areacode	
		,@send,DATE_FORMAT(now(),'%Y%m%d%H%i%s') as d_com,@b_year+543 as b_year

		,COUNT(DISTINCT if(DATE_FORMAT(s.DATETIME_DISCH,'%Y%m%d') BETWEEN @start_d AND @end_d,CONCAT(s.hospcode,'-',s.an),NULL)) as ball
		,SUM(s.day) as aall

		,COUNT(DISTINCT if(s.instype in(SELECT instypecode FROM cinstype_new WHERE instypegroup in(1))
										,CONCAT(s.hospcode,'-',s.an),NULL)) as b1
		,SUM(if(s.instype in(SELECT instypecode FROM cinstype_new WHERE instypegroup in(1)) ,s.day,0)) as a1

		,COUNT(DISTINCT if(s.instype in(SELECT instypecode FROM cinstype_new WHERE instypegroup in(2))
										,CONCAT(s.hospcode,'-',s.an),NULL)) as b2
		,SUM(if(s.instype in(SELECT instypecode FROM cinstype_new WHERE instypegroup in(2)) ,s.day,0)) as a2

		,COUNT(DISTINCT if(s.instype in(SELECT instypecode FROM cinstype_new WHERE instypegroup in(3,4))
										,CONCAT(s.hospcode,'-',s.an),NULL)) as b3
		,SUM(if(s.instype in(SELECT instypecode FROM cinstype_new WHERE instypegroup in(3,4)) ,s.day,0)) as a3

		,COUNT(DISTINCT if(s.instype in(SELECT instypecode FROM cinstype_new WHERE instypegroup in(5,6))
										,CONCAT(s.hospcode,'-',s.an),NULL)) as b4
		,SUM(if(s.instype in(SELECT instypecode FROM cinstype_new WHERE instypegroup in(5,6)) ,s.day,0)) as a4

		,COUNT(DISTINCT if(s.instype not in(SELECT instypecode FROM cinstype_new)
										,CONCAT(s.hospcode,'-',s.an),NULL)) as b5
		,SUM(if(s.instype not in(SELECT instypecode FROM cinstype_new) ,s.day,0)) as a5
	FROM
		tmp_admission s,chospital h
	WHERE
		s.hospcode=h.hoscode
		AND DATE_FORMAT(s.datetime_disch,'%Y%m%d') BETWEEN @start_d AND @end_d
		AND h.provcode = @prov_c
	GROUP BY
	hospcode,areacode
);

zone.query: SELECT h.zone_code as a_code ,h.zone_name as a_name, SUM("visit_all") as "result" ,SUM("inscl_all") as "target" , ROUND(((SUM("visit_all"))/(NULLIF(SUM("inscl_all"),0))),2) as "p"  ,SUM("inscl_visit1") as "result1",SUM("inscl1") as "target1" ,ROUND(((SUM("inscl_visit1"))/(NULLIF(SUM("inscl1"),0))),2) as "p1"  ,SUM("inscl_visit2") as "result2",SUM("inscl2") as "target2" ,ROUND(((SUM("inscl_visit2"))/(NULLIF(SUM("inscl2"),0))),2) as "p2"  ,SUM("inscl_visit3") as "result3",SUM("inscl3") as "target3" ,ROUND(((SUM("inscl_visit3"))/(NULLIF(SUM("inscl3"),0))),2) as "p3"  ,SUM("inscl_visit4") as "result4",SUM("inscl4") as "target4" ,ROUND(((SUM("inscl_visit4"))/(NULLIF(SUM("inscl4"),0))),2) as "p4"  ,SUM("inscl_visit5") as "result5",SUM("inscl5") as "target5" ,ROUND(((SUM("inscl_visit5"))/(NULLIF(SUM("inscl5"),0))),2) as "p5"  FROM chospital_regis as h LEFT JOIN {{S_TABLE}} as s ON h.hoscode=s.hospcode AND s.b_year={{YEAR}} AND {{YYMMFREEZE}} LEFT JOIN ccmihosp ON s.hospcode = ccmihosp.hcode AND ccmihosp.byear = {{YEAR}} LEFT JOIN cmastercup ON s.hospcode = cmastercup.hsub WHERE (h.zone_code = {{ZONE_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{ZONE_CODE}}) AND (h.chw_code = {{PROVINCE_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{PROVINCE_CODE}}) AND (h.amp_code = {{DISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{DISTRICT_FULL_CODE}}) AND (h.tmb_code = {{SUBDISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{SUBDISTRICT_FULL_CODE}}) AND (h.dep = {{DEPARTMENT_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{DEPARTMENT_CODE}}) AND (h.mcode IN ({{ORGANIZATION_TYPE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{ORGANIZATION_TYPE}})) AND (h.mcode IN ({{MINISTRY_CODE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{MINISTRY_CODE}})) AND (h.hoscode IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}})) AND (ccmihosp.splevel = {{SERVICE_PLAN_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{SERVICE_PLAN_CODE}}) AND (cmastercup.hsub IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}})) GROUP BY h.zone_code,h.zone_name ORDER BY h.zone_code
